ios.desc:
Build your rota once. RotaFlow keeps your shifts, sleep, pay, and time off clear.

Made for healthcare workers, emergency responders, manufacturing teams, and anyone working rotating Day, Night, and Off patterns, RotaFlow is a calm, private shift planner for iPhone, Apple Watch, widgets, and Siri.

YOUR ROTA AT A GLANCE
• Create repeating schedules from popular presets—including 4-on/4-off, Pitman, Panama, DuPont, and DDNNOO - or build your own pattern.
• Keep multiple personal rotas, switch between them, and see every shift in a clear calendar and upcoming list.
• Add swaps, holidays, vacation, sick leave, training, on-call duty, and other exceptions without changing the base rotation.

SLEEP & FATIGUE INSIGHTS
• Optionally connect read-only Apple Health sleep data.
• Fatigue Guard highlights potential risk from your sleep trends, recovery, night shifts, and consecutive workdays—all processed on device.
• See simple explanations and affected days, receive low-noise alerts, and open smarter swap options from a flagged shift.

HOURS, PAY & TIME OFF
• Set Day and Night hours, unpaid breaks, rates, pay cycles, premiums, weekend or holiday multipliers, and overtime rules.
• Automatically estimate paid hours and gross pay, including overnight shifts.
• Track overtime and PTO, find leave windows that create longer breaks, and review availability, forecasts, and yearly insights.

BUILT FOR APPLE. PRIVATE BY DESIGN.
• Check your next shift with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Apple Watch complications, Siri, and Shortcuts.
• Add shifts to Apple Calendar, share or import supported .ics files, and coordinate swaps through Trade Board.
• Your schedules and sleep analysis are local-first. Optional iCloud sync is off by default.

FREE & PRO
Free includes rota setup, Dashboard, core Fatigue Guard and Siri features, reminders, and 7-day sharing.

Pro unlocks extended planning, advanced sleep and pay insights, richer widgets and complications, precise reminders, PTO tools, advanced overtime summaries, Trade Board features, and more.

RotaFlow Pro is available monthly, yearly, or as a lifetime purchase. Manage or cancel subscriptions in Apple ID settings.

Fatigue and sleep insights are informational and are not medical advice.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
I built RotaFlow to solve the UX disaster of current shift work apps. Most incumbents are web-wrappers laden with ads.

The Stack:

* Language: Swift 6 / SwiftUI.
* Persistence: Core Data synced via CloudKit (NSPersistentCloudKitContainer).
* Architecture: MVVM with a custom "LoopEngine" for O(1) shift calculation.

The Interesting Part:
I implemented a "Future Cliff" paywall. The app is fully functional for the next 30 days. Accessing dates beyond t+30d triggers a blurred UI layer. This aligns monetization with the value of long-term planning (vacations/weddings) rather than daily usage.

I'm a solo dev and handled everything from the icon design to the CloudKit schema.

Website: https://www.rotaflow.app
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758777908

Feedback on the onboarding flow (specifically the pattern builder dial) would be appreciated.
